title: A Primer on Spacetime Singularities II: Spatially Homogeneous Cosmologies
summary: This article is the second part of a review devoted to spacetime singularities in classical General Relativity. While Primer I developed the mathematical framework for defining, classifying, and proving the existence of singularities, the present work examines their concrete realization in spatially homogeneous cosmological models.
